settings_theme_hint: The theme is kept in the shop file, so a second machine opens on it.
field_barcode_hint: Leave empty to number it automatically
error_duplicate_barcode: That barcode is already in use.
error_exhausted: No numbers left in this series.
error_unauthorized: This window is not allowed to call the till. Restart the app.
settings_hint: What the shop prints, which régime it sells under, and how its file is kept.
settings_store_hint: This block prints at the top of every ticket and every invoice.
regime_change_hint: The change applies to sales from that day on. Tickets already issued keep the regime they were made under.
settings_backups_hint: A copy of the shop file is taken every day. The last thirty are kept.
backups_empty_hint: The first copy is taken tonight, or right now with the button below.
backups_confirm_restore: Everything changed since will be lost. A copy of the current state is kept beside the shop file.
settings_safety_copies_hint: Every restore first keeps a copy of the state it replaced, beside the shop file. These are never deleted.
error_restart_needed: The shop file is no longer open in the app. Close it and start it again.
error_restore_failed_restart_needed: The restore did not happen and the shop file could not be reopened. Nothing was replaced. Close the app and start it again.
till_search: Search a product or scan a barcode
error_qty_whole: This product is sold by whole units.
error_discount_above_line: The discount is above the line.
error_discount_above_total: The discount is above the basket.
error_tendered_short: The cash given is below the amount due.
error_print: The ticket could not be prepared for printing.
field_opening_debt_hint: What the customer already owed before the software. It cannot be edited afterwards: a mistake is corrected by an adjustment.
customers_adjust_hint: A positive amount raises the debt, a negative one lowers it.
customers_adjust_confirm: Save this adjustment? It joins the customer's statement and stays visible.
error_amount_zero: An adjustment of zero corrects nothing.
customers_pay_hint: The payment settles the oldest documents first. It cannot be more than the debt.
customers_closed_still_collects: Closed fiche: payments and corrections still go through, sales do not.
customers_pay_confirm: Take this payment? It goes on the customer's statement and stays there.
customers_payment_settled_none: No document: the payment goes against the balance.
error_payment_above_debt: The payment is more than the customer owes. Outstanding:
customers_statement_hint: The statement covers both days, included.
customers_debt_slip_hint: The 80 mm slip handed to the customer at the counter. No fiscal value.
error_statement_range_invalid: The end day is before the start day.
error_payment_amount_zero: A payment of nothing settles nothing.
pay_credit_needs_customer: Pick a customer who can buy on credit.
till_override_confirm: Sell past this customer's credit limit? The decision goes in the audit log.
till_near_limit_sold: This customer has reached their warning threshold.
error_credit_limit: This sale goes past the customer's credit limit.
error_credit_needs_customer: A credit sale needs a customer.
till_facture_needs_customer: A facture is made out to a named customer.
error_party_ids: This facture cannot be issued yet: identifiers are missing.
till_party_ids_seller: The shop's own block is missing:
documents_cancel_stock_only: The document keeps its number and the goods go back into stock.
documents_cancel_with_avoir: The document keeps its number, the goods go back into stock and {amount} DA come off the customer's account.
documents_cancel_nothing: The document keeps its number. Nothing else moves: the goods have already come back on credit notes and the customer's account is settled.
documents_subtitle: Every numbered paper the shop has issued, and what can still be done to one.
documents_empty_hint: Receipts and invoices made at the counter turn up here.
documents_avoir_hint: Put the quantity coming back on each line. A line left empty is not credited.
documents_cancel_hint: The number stays on the register. Say why the shop is cancelling this paper.
till_proforma_needs_customer: A proforma is made out to a customer: pick one.
customers_close_reason_hint: This account is not settled; say why the fiche is being closed. The reason goes into the log with the balance.
expenses_empty_hint: Rent, electricity, salaries: everything that leaves the till and is not stock.
expenses_form_hint: An expense is written once. It is never edited and never deleted.
expenses_note_hint: What the accountant needs to read in six months. Optional.
cash_refunds_hint: An avoir credits the customer's account and brings the goods back; it takes no money out of the till.
error_expense_amount_zero: An expense is an amount above zero.
suppliers_empty_hint: Add the first supplier: the fiche keeps their contact details, their identifiers and what the shop owes them.
suppliers_fiche_hint: The supplier's contact details and identifiers. The movements are read on the statement.
field_supplier_opening_debt_hint: What the shop already owed this supplier before the software. It is not edited afterwards: a mistake is corrected by an adjustment.
suppliers_pay_hint: The payment settles the oldest orders first. It cannot go above what is owed.
suppliers_pay_confirm: Record this payment? It goes on the supplier's account and stays there.
suppliers_adjust_hint: A positive amount raises what the shop owes, a negative one lowers it.
suppliers_adjust_confirm: Record this adjustment? It goes on the supplier's account and stays there.
suppliers_close_hint: The shop stops buying from this supplier. The fiche stays: money and corrections still go on it.
suppliers_closed_still_pays: Fiche closed: the shop still pays and still corrects, it no longer buys.
error_supplier_name_taken: Another supplier already carries that name.
error_supplier_payment_above_debt: The payment is above what the shop owes this supplier. Still owed:
error_conflict: That value is already used in this shop.
error_name_too_long: Name too long: 200 characters at most.
purchases_empty_hint: Orders placed with suppliers show up here.
purchases_line_incomplete: A line needs a product, a quantity and a unit cost.
purchases_no_day: The shop's day is not known yet.
purchases_landed_hint: Transport and extra costs are spread over the lines by value, once and for all, when the order is saved.
purchases_receive_now_hint: Stock and what the shop owes move on delivery, never on the order alone.
purchases_receive_hint: What arrived. Stock rises and what the shop owes the supplier rises with it.
purchases_return_hint: What goes back: stock falls and the debt with it. No document is issued.
purchases_cancel_hint: Only while nothing has arrived. The reason is recorded.
purchases_close_short_hint: The rest will never come. What arrived stays owed, the rest is written off. The reason is recorded.
field_receive_now: The goods came with the note
error_amount_unreadable: Amount or quantity cannot be read.
settings_stock_recount_hint: Every night the quantity on hand is worked out again from the movements. The movement ledger is what counts: the quantity stored on the product is corrected from it.
stock_recount_none: Nothing was out at the last recount.
stock_recount_corrected: The stored quantity was corrected from the movement ledger.
stock_recount_marks_today: A recount counts the stock now and marks today as done: a difference that appears later today waits for tomorrow's recount, or for another press of this button.
settings_export_import_hint: The shop's tables as Excel files, and products created or updated from a file.
export_range_hint: The days apply to the sales export only. Left empty, it takes everything.
import_hint: Download the template, fill it in, then check the file before importing it. A barcode the shop already uses updates that product instead of opening a second one.
import_fix_first: Fix the refused rows in the file, then check it again. Nothing is written while one row is refused.
import_reason_rate_not_allowed: this TVA rate is not one of the allowed ones
import_reason_rate_missing: a new category needs the rate of its row
import_reason_duplicate_in_file: this barcode is on another row of this file
error_label_no_barcode: This product has no EAN-13 barcode, so there is no label to print.
import_reason_too_many_decimals: too many decimals: a price has two, a quantity three
error_label_not_ean13: This product's code is not a thirteen-digit EAN-13, so there are no bars to print.
error_label_too_many: Too many products selected for one sheet of labels.
import_update_keeps_stock: The rows being updated change the name and the prices. They leave stock alone: an import never moves quantities.
